lines.serbian: Katarina živi u Danskoj, ali njena baka živi u Zadru.
lines.croatian: Katarina živi u Danskoj, ali njezina baka živi u Zadru.
lines.english: Katarina lives in Denmark, but her grandmother lives in Zadar.

lines.serbian: Svake godine u julu putuje u Hrvatsku.
lines.croatian: Svake godine u srpnju putuje u Hrvatsku.
lines.english: Every year in July she travels to Croatia.

lines.serbian: Leti do Splita, a onda ide autobusom do Zadra.
lines.croatian: Leti do Splita, a onda ide autobusom do Zadra.
lines.english: She flies to Split and then takes a bus to Zadar.

lines.serbian: Baka je čeka na autobuskoj stanici.
lines.croatian: Baka je čeka na autobusnom kolodvoru.
lines.english: Her grandmother is waiting for her at the bus station.
"You're not! Come on, lunch is ready."

lines.serbian: Kod kuće je sto pun hrane: riba, blitva, hleb i kolači.
lines.croatian: Kod kuće je stol pun hrane: riba, blitva, kruh i kolači.
lines.english: At home the table is full of food: fish, chard, bread and cakes.

lines.serbian: Dolaze i ujak, tetka i mali rođaci.
lines.croatian: Dolaze i ujak, teta i mali bratići.
lines.english: Her uncle, her aunt and her little cousins come too.
Everyone talks at the same time.

lines.serbian: Katarina ne razume sve, ali se smeje.
lines.croatian: Katarina ne razumije sve, ali se smije.
lines.english: Katarina doesn't understand everything, but she laughs.

lines.serbian: Posle ručka baka je vodi na terasu.
lines.croatian: Nakon ručka baka je vodi na terasu.
lines.english: After lunch her grandmother takes her out on the terrace.
You can see the sea from here.

lines.serbian: – Hoćeš li ostati duže ove godine? – pita baka.
lines.croatian: – Hoćeš li ostati duže ove godine? – pita baka.
lines.english: "Will you stay longer this year?" asks her grandmother.
Her grandmother takes her by the hand.

lines.serbian: – Onda jedi brzo. Imamo mnogo hrane!
lines.croatian: – Onda jedi brzo. Imamo puno hrane!
lines.english: "Then eat fast. We have a lot of food!"
